title: Love Story
start: Speak to Mabel at the barn north-east of Draynor Village.

items.t: Weapons and armour for at least 2 combat styles (or Necromancy)

recommended.t: Good armour, food and weapons for multiple combat styles as Zenevivia may use protection prayers. In order to save inventory space, the use of Necromancy or hybrid armour may be recommended for mid-to-high-level players. Alternatively, the use of power armour, tank armour, or items that boost life points in order to increase a player's damage/defence is recommendable.

For this quest, prioritise the use of combat styles and equipment which specialise in long-ranged attack capabilities, or the ability to damage an opponent from a distance. Players may find use of the Ranged combat style to be exceptionally helpful if not using Necromancy. In addition to the use of Ranged equipment, a Halberd-type weapon may be useful for a Melee style switch -- preferably a Noxious scythe, Attuned crystal halberd, Crystal halberd, or a Dragon halberd. Alternatively, players may also use the Magic combat style, but possibly to a lesser degree of effectiveness than the methods stated above.
During your fights, you will not be allowed to summon a familiar, as the Wise Old Man will be following you.

Items to restore Prayer points or reduced stats: Prayer potions, Super restore potions, Prayer renewal potions, or Super prayer potions. Additionally, a player may bring Adrenaline potions or Replenishment potions if they have access to them.
Items to boost combat stats: Super sets, Extreme potions, Overloads, Holy overload potions, Supreme overload potions, or Supreme overload salves.

rewards.t: Any unused Teleport to house tablets (as many as 99)
Ability to chip Teleport to house tablets
Ability to use the Dark Stone exterior style for a player-owned house
Ability to use the dark stone slabs floor style in a player-owned house
Zenevivia can be faced in the Dominion Tower

steps.t: Talk to Mabel in the barn east of the Draynor Village lodestone. [Chat: 1 Can you tell me what's wrong? › Accept › 3 Okay, off I go.]
Go up the ladder.
Solve the hay bale puzzle:

sub.t: As you arrive, go north once and push the one hay bale there all the way to the western wall.
Standing where you are, push a pair of hay bales at your immediate south twice.
Go one square east and push another pair of hay bales to the south.
Push the single hay bale directly west of you.
Finally, push the two hay bales to the south of you to clear the path.

steps.t: Pick up the ring.
Climb down the ladder.
Talk to Zenevivia. [Chat: 3 What's happened to Mabel? › 2 Are you going to give Mabel her ring? › 1 What do you want me to do? › 3 Okay, off I go.]
Search any hay bale for a twig, give it to her.
Talk to her again. [Chat: 2 Will you return Mabel's ring and leave now? › 2 I'm trying to complete this quest. › 5 Alright, I'll accept. I'll make you regret this!]
p: The correct solution to the hay bale puzzle

steps.t: Go to Draynor Village and talk to the Wise Old Man. [Chat: 1 A woman called Zenevivia wishes to challenge us.]

sub.t: This option may not show up unless the quest Garden of Tranquillity is completed if you started it.

steps.t: After the cutscene, talk to him outside his house. If you have a familiar summoned then you must dismiss it to be able to progress. [Chat: 2 No. › 1 Yes, let's go.]
Head to the Rimmington house portal, talk to him again. (Teleport to Port Sarim and head west.) [Chat: Any › 3 How can we get in there?]
When he leaves, walk to the north-eastern house in Rimmington and talk to him once more. [Chat: 2 Yes, I'm ready.]
Open the "chipped" teleport to house tablet, solve the puzzle by dragging and dropping tiles from the left side on to the correct spots according to the photo here.
While standing next to the Wise Old Man, break the chipped tablet.
Enter the dungeon. [Chat: 2 Traps? Very dangerous. You go first.]
After the cutscene, continue dialogue with the Wise Old Man. [Chat: 2 What are we going to build?]
Craft via on the Clockmaker's bench in the workshop room. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Use the bench again to create a dummy. [Chat: 1 Okay, I'll get on with it.]
Enter the dungeon. During this part, there will be a pulsating purple light around your screen. Any players sensitive to flashing lights should proceed with caution.
Traverse through the dungeon, deactivating all the traps by walking on them and then return to the surface.

sub.t: Pit guardian rooms have 2 traps each, except for the scabarite room, having only one.

steps.t: Climb the staircase. [Chat: 1 Yes, get it out now.]
Enter the dungeon. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm sure I found them all. Let's enter.]
Traverse through the dungeon, killing all the enemies (high-level players need not worry about using super antifire for the iron dragon as it is fairly weak and may be killed quickly).
Enter the final door, talk to the Wise Old Man. [Chat: Any › 2 She's insane; let's kill her and leave! › 4 Okay, let's go and face her.]
Climb the stairs.

Talk to Zenevivia to start the battle. If you fail your first attempts, return to the Wise Old Man at the house in Rimmington. Right click on the house teleport tabs to modify them for another teleport to the fight.

sub.t: Avoid the flames on the floor, they deal low damage.
Zenevivia uses magic spells and flames on the floor that can quickly deal around 600 damage.
She will sometimes use protection prayers so prepare to switch attack styles or just use Necromancy.
She can be knocked off pillars using abilities that knock back enemies, such as Kick.

p: The Wise Old Man helps the player build the magical dummy.
You and the Wise Old Man battle through the dungeon.

steps.t: After she is defeated, talk to her.
You will return to Draynor Village.
Talk to Zenevivia in the Wise Old Man's house. [Chat: 4 Have you still got Mabel's ring? › 2 When will you give me Mabel's ring? › 1 Stealing is wrong. › 1 When are you going to attack?]
Go upstairs and look through the telescope and watch the Wizards' Tower Robbery.
Head downstairs, talk to Zenevivia again. [Chat: 1 Are you going to try any more robberies? › 1 Can I have Mabel's ring back now?]
Quest complete!
